title: iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra full specs leak
description: Less than 24 hours before their official unveiling, the full specs of both the iQOO 16 and the iQOO Pad Ultra have been outed today courtesy of Digital Chat Station on Weibo. So, according to him, the iQOO 16 has a 6.85-inch Samsung M16 "LEAD" OLED screen with "2K+" resolution and a 165Hz refresh rate, and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset at the helm paired with iQOO's Q4 self-developed gaming chip. The phone has a 50MP main camera using a 1/1.3-inch type sensor, a 50MP ultrawide, a 50MP periscope telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom using Sony's IMX882 sensor, a 32MP...

title: Global Oppo Find X10 runs Geekbench, here's what's changed from the Chinese version
description: Last week, Oppo unveiled the Find X10 for the Chinese market (alongside the Find X10 Pro Max). In the meantime, the global variant of the Find X10 may have run Geekbench. It was spotted in the benchmark's online database with the model number CPH2911. As you can see in the screenshot below, it managed a single-core score of 2,528 and a multi-core score of 8,709 in Geekbench 7.1.0 for Android. The specific prototype which ran the benchmark had 12GB of RAM. It was of course running Android 17, same as the Chinese version of this phone. The global Find X10 identifies its chipset as...

title: Samsung Galaxy A08 4G, F08 4G, and M08 4G have their prices in India revealed
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A08 4G about a couple of weeks ago, and the device is on its way to India too, among many other markets. It also seems like Samsung will be releasing a Galaxy F08 4G and a Galaxy M08 4G in the country as well, the former for Flipkart and the latter for Amazon. According to a tipster over on X, the Galaxy A08 4G will be priced at INR 18,499 (about $192), while both the F08 4G and the M08 4G will go for INR 16,999 ($177) instead. All three of them will be offered at these prices with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of storage. It's still not exactly clear when these...

title: Standard Xiaomi 18 said to offer dual 200MP cameras, complete specs tipped
description: Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro series in China last week, but unlike last year, the standard Xiaomi 18 was not part of the announcement. The base variant is rumored to launch separately in December, and a tipster has now revealed its complete specifications. According to tipster Panda is Bald on Weibo, the standard Xiaomi 18 will also feature a dual 200MP rear camera setup, similar to the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. The phone is tipped to feature a 1/1.28 inch 200MP primary sensor and a 200MP periscope telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom. The tipster also claims that the handset...

title: Here's our first look at the Huawei Mate 90 series, including the Mate 90 RS
description: The Huawei Mate 90 series is yet to be announced, and Huawei has already revealed the announcement date on one of its teaser posters - October 1. But in addition to the teaser, multiple leaked images online reveal not only the Huawei Mate 90 and Mate 90 Pro's design, but also the Mate 90 RS as well. Huawei Mate 90 Pro • Huawei Mate 90 RS It looks like the Mate 90 and 90 Pro will arrive in two-tone designs in green, pink, black and white. The renders show only the Mate 90 Pro, but we assume the vanilla Mate 90 will adopt the same color schemes. In fact, a leaked live image below...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ now has an official launch date
description: Last week, RedMagic revealed that it would be launching the RedMagic 12 Pro+ in October, while also showing some bits of the phone's design. Now, the brand has finally confirmed the exact launch date for its next flagship device: October 15. The event will be held by the company at 2:30 PM local time in China. The phone will unsurprisingly be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC, and RedMagic promises that it's applied its "first-class tuning" for a significantly improved gaming experience with better visuals. There's also an overall improvement in the phone's...

title: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro unveiled with triple drivers, improved ANC, and premium build
description: After several teasers, Nothing has finally unveiled its flagship over-ear headphones, the Headphone (1) Pro. The new headphones offer triple drivers, improved ANC with a 10 mic setup, and a premium build that uses glass and titanium. The Nothing Headphone (1) Pro features a 40mm dynamic driver for bass, another precision dynamic driver, and an xMEMS driver with a silicone diaphragm for treble. The headphones offer Dynamic Spatial Audio with head tracking that offers several modes such as Standard, Live House, Club, Concert Hall, and a special mode that’s based on the Studio B by...

title: Motorola's wide foldable now has a name and its specs are out
description: Earlier this month, some sketches leaked purporting to show Motorola’s upcoming wide foldable, which is expected to arrive at some point in the next few months. A few days later, the company started teasing the device, confirming that it's real. Now a new leak brings us the device's specs. And maybe its name too? It is apparently being called Razr Flex internally, but it's not yet clear if this is its final name. For what it's worth, this isn't the codename - that's Parker, apparently. title: Conflicting reports surface about the Galaxy S27 Ultra's camera positioning
description: Previous rumors have already suggested that the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will have a revamped camera island design, with an iPhone-esque plateau taking almost the entire width of the back. Inside it, the cameras will still be laid out in the left part. According to a new rumor, the telephoto camera will be the one on the right, with a microphone right under it, some unnamed "sensors" under that, and the circular LED flash below those. This source also notes that the microphone hole seems to be missing from recent renders shown by Ice Universe. However, Ice Universe has...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro vs. Pixel 11 Pro XL
description: The Pixel 11 series was announced back in August, and the dust has already settled. But if you're looking to get the latest and greatest hardware from Google, you're probably wondering which Pixel to get. The most common dilemma is between the Google Pixel 11 Pro and the Google Pixel 11 Pro XL. And aside from the obvious size difference, the two phones are more different than you might think. So if size isn't a deciding factor for you, you may want to know which one has the better battery life, for example, or which one charges faster. And are there any other differences that aren't...

title: The Galaxy S25 series plus the Galaxy Z Fold7 and Z Flip7 are now getting stable One UI 9
description: Samsung announced the One UI 9 update for the S26 series – it started rolling out in South Korea first (September 16) and reached the US a week later (September 23). Now, the latest version of One UI (which is built on top of Android 17) has come to the 2025 Galaxy flagships. Galaxy S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra users in Korea are reporting that they received the notification for the new update earlier today. Even the ones that weren’t part of the beta program. If the timing is the same as with the S26 series, folks in the US should get the notification next week. A Galaxy S25 (Korean...

title: Qualcomm confirms it wants to use Samsung's 2nm process
description: A couple of weeks or so ago, a rumor surfaced about Qualcomm still being in talks with Samsung about the latter's 2nm process node, and possibly using Samsung Foundry to make some of the recently launched Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips. That has not panned out, as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips are made by TSMC just like most recent high-end Snapdragons. However, a new report claims Qualcomm's Senior Vice President and Head of Mobile Handsets, Chris Patrick, has confirmed that his company is "conducting in-depth work regarding Samsung's 2nm process technology", also calling what...

title: Honor MagicPad 4 (12.1) and X10 Pro Max arrive
description: Alongside the brand new Magic9 series phones, Honor also announced a pair of new Android tablets with the MagicPad 4 12.1 and the more budget-friendly X10 Pro Max. MagicPad 4 (12.1) The MagicPad 4 (12.1) should not be confused with the MagicPad4, which launched back in June. That one brings a 12.3-inch OLED display alongside the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip and a 10,100mAh battery. As its name suggests, the new MagicPad 4 (12.1) features a marginally smaller 12.1-inch IPS LCD with a 1,872 x 3,000 px resolution, a 165Hz refresh rate and 700 nits of brightness. title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max sold 1.3 million units in China during the first week, beating the 17 Pros
description: During the pre-order period in China, retailers quickly ran out of available iPhone 18 Pro series units – according to estimates, 7 million units were pre-ordered. Some stores saw double the revenue compared to the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max launch last year. This momentum has carried over into actual sales too. According to information by blogger RD Observation, the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max have sold approximately 1.3 million units during the first week of availability in China. This is 15% more units than what the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max sold last year during their first week....

title: The HMD 106 Pure appears out of nowhere - a super cheap 2G phone with FM radio
description: One of our readers sent us a tip about the HMD 106 Pure – a feature phone that appears on an online store in Pakistan, but that we couldn’t find on HMD.com. We did find an HMD 105 Pure that uses an older design, though. The HMD 106 Pure looks a lot like the HMD 101. However, it’s powered by a different chipset, the Unisoc 6531E. It still only has basic GSM connectivity – this means that it can’t be used in regions that have already or will soon sundown their 2G networks. This chip is used in other models, e.g. the HMD 102, but that one has a camera – if you can call the 320 x 240p module a...

title: The Honor Watch 6 Pro has a 1.5" dual-layer OLED display, HRV and CGM tracking
description: A few months ago, Honor unveiled the impressive Watch 6 – it measured only 10.8mm thick, but packed a massive 980mAh battery for up to 35 days of typical usage. There’s also the Plus model with a 1,000mAh Si/C battery. Now the company is unveiling a more capable Pro model that trades battery endurance for features. The Honor Watch 6 Pro impresses with a 1.5” dual-layer OLED display (466 x 466px). It has 4,500 nits peak global brightness and, if a smaller region of the screen is on, it can go up to 5,500 nits. title: The Oppo F35 series is going official next week
description: Oppo is celebrating 10 years of its F series in India and has announced the launch date for the upcoming F35 lineup. The company has also revealed the design and color options of the two phones. The Oppo F35 series will launch in India on October 5 and will include a standard model and the F35 Pro. Oppo has shared a couple of teasers for the F35 and F35 Pro, revealing their available color options. The F35 Pro will be available in three color options, with two featuring a textured rear panel. It will be offered in Orange, Light Blue, and Matte Black. Meanwhile, the...

title: Honor Magic9 and Magic9 Super Edition announced
description: Honor is unveiling three new flagship models today – the Pro Max is covered in a separate article, here we will look at the Magic9 and the Magic9 Super Edition. The Honor Magic9 is a relatively small (6.37” display) camera powerhouse with a large 8,000mAh battery. The Honor Magic9 Super Edition brings an even bigger 11,000mAh battery (and has a 6.81” screen), but its most interesting feature may be the 30,000 rpm active cooling fan. title: Here's when the OnePlus 16 is launching
description: After recently revealing the color options and full camera details of the upcoming OnePlus 16, the company has now announced the phone’s launch date in China. The OnePlus 16 will launch in China on October 12. The company announced the launch date at its 2026 OnePlus Gaming Conference in China, where it also detailed the upcoming flagship’s gaming capabilities. The OnePlus 16 was recently confirmed to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. title: Honor Magic9 Pro Max arrives with 200MP main cam, ARRI camera tuning and SD 8 Elite Gen 6 Extreme chip
description: The Magic9 Pro Max is Honor’s top-tier phone, and it checks all of the boxes for a late 2026 Android flagship. Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (✓), dual 200 MP cameras(✓), a massive 8,800mAh Si-C battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging (✓). It’s also positioning itself as a professional-grade video camera alongside Honor’s budding partnership with German camera maker ARRI. Magic9 Pro Max gets a new 23mm equivalent 200MP main cam armed with a 1/1.28-inch sensor and f/1.6 aperture.
